title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-Endpoint DLP support classification of Azure RMS protected Office documents
description: Endpoint DLP can now classify Office files stored in Windows devices that have Azure RMS protection applied.  Classification will be triggered when file is used in applications or when just-in-time classification is enabled.
